articles.title: Photography students focus on Hartlepool street for exhibition
articles.summary: Images of Hartlepool's Church Street in the 1970s sit alongside pictures from the present day.
articles.body:
A street's past and present is the focus of a photography exhibition as the area shapes up to become part of a hub for the screen industry.

Degree students from the Northern School of Art in Hartlepool have been documenting the town's Church Street.

Their work is being displayed alongside pictures of the street and other parts of Teesside taken by artist and photographer Peter Benson from the late 1960s onwards.

The exhibition, called Reframing the Region, is running at the school's campus on Church Street until 30 November.

The project stemmed from images taken in 2025 by then-student Stephen Bailes, with Hartlepool Council later granting him access to a number of vacant properties after seeing his end-of-year show.

Bailes said the authority provided information "about the past, present and future of the buildings", including the area's planned regeneration to host a production village aimed at giving filmmakers everything needed to make a movie or TV programme.

Current degree students had been able to build on Bailes's initial research, the school said, as they worked with Benson.

The latter had been a student at the Cleveland College of Art in Middlesbrough when he began taking his own photographs in Hartlepool and the surrounding areas.

Benson said his black-and-white images "show the demolition and clearance of the built environment in the Teesside area, when inner-city redevelopment was high on the political agenda".

"Many of the images reflect those times and convey the social and historical significance of the changes which took place within the landscape of this region."

Councillor Rob Darby, chair of Hartlepool Borough Council's housing, growth and communities committee, said Church Street had "played a central role in [the town's] story for generations".

"It is exciting to see talented young photographers helping to capture and celebrate this important part of our heritage at such a pivotal moment in its history," he added.

"This exhibition offers a fascinating insight into how Church Street has evolved over the decades."

In October it was announced the council had secured £910,000 from Historic England to help fund repairs to buildings on the street at risk of decay.

That followed approval for a £33.5m expansion of The Northern Studios in the town, which would see derelict buildings brought back into use for filmmakers.

The studios have already been used to produce feature film Jackdaw, the BBC comedy Smoggie Queens and ITV dramas.

articles.title: Nabor Wanderley é o novo secretário de Educação da Paraíba | G1
articles.standfirst: Ex-prefeito de Patos, na Paraíba, foi anunciado como secretário de educação da pasta na noite desta terça-feira (24).
articles.summary: O ex-prefeito de Patos Nabor Wanderley assume a Secretaria de Educação da Paraíba após anúncio oficial feito pelo governador Lucas Ribeiro nesta terça-feira (24).
articles.body:
Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

Nabor Wanderley (Republicanos), ex-prefeito de Patos, no Sertão, foi anunciado como o novo secretário de Educação da Paraíba, na noite desta terça-feira (24). O anúncio foi feito ao lado do governador Lucas Ribeiro (PP).

Anteriormente, a pasta era comandada por Erivonaldo Alves da Silva, que agora passa a comandar a Secretaria Executiva de Cooperação com os Municípios, função que exercia antes de assumir o cargo na Educação.

Natural de Patos, Nabor Wanderley é formado em Direito pela Universidade Estadual da Paraíba (UFPB). Foi prefeito de Patos por quatro mandatos e também exerceu mandato de deputado estadual. Ele concorreu ao cargo de senador nas eleições em outubro, mas não foi eleito. Leia mais abaixo .

No anúncio, o governador Lucas Ribeiro elogiou a trajetória de Nabor Wanderley e disse acreditar em resultados positivos na pasta.

“Estamos trazendo para a Secretaria de Educação um gestor com experiência administrativa, capacidade de articulação e resultados concretos na educação. Nabor construiu uma trajetória de trabalho em Patos e conhece os desafios da gestão pública. Queremos aproveitar essa experiência para fortalecer ainda mais a educação paraibana, avançando na qualidade do ensino e na parceria com os municípios”, afirmou.

Nabor Wanderley é anunciado como novo secretário de Educação da Paraíba — Foto: Secom/PB

Nabor Wanderley da Nóbrega Filho nasceu em 14 de setembro de 1965, em Campina Grande, no Agreste da Paraíba. Formado em Direito pela Universidade Estadual da Paraíba (UEPB), é advogado e filiado ao Republicanos. Filho do ex-prefeito de Patos Nabor Wanderley da Nóbrega e pai do deputado federal Hugo Motta, construiu sua carreira política em Patos, no Sertão paraibano.

Nabor iniciou sua trajetória política como prefeito de Patos, cargo que exerceu por dois períodos. Foi eleito pela primeira vez em 2004 e reeleito em 2008, permanecendo à frente da prefeitura até 2012.

Em 2014, foi eleito deputado estadual da Paraíba. Exerceu o mandato entre 2015 e 2018 e foi reeleito naquele ano, permanecendo na Assembleia Legislativa da Paraíba (ALPB) até 2020.

Nas eleições de 2020, Nabor voltou a disputar a Prefeitura de Patos e foi eleito novamente. Em 2024, foi reeleito para um novo mandato à frente do município.

Em abril de 2026, renunciou ao cargo de prefeito para concorrer a uma das duas vagas da Paraíba no Senado Federal pelo Republicanos. Com a saída de Nabor, o vice-prefeito Jacob Souto assumiu a chefia do Executivo municipal.

articles.title: Nova rodoviária de Cubatão começa a funcionar em dezembro; veja linhas | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo a prefeitura, terminal no Jardim Casqueiro inicia as operações em fase de testes, das 5h às 21h. Espaço terá três linhas municipais e viagens para São Paulo e São Bernardo do Campo.
articles.summary: Segundo a prefeitura, terminal no Jardim Casqueiro inicia as operações em fase de testes, das 5h às 21h.
articles.body:
Nova rodoviária de Cubatão (SP) — Foto: Divulgação / Prefeitura de Cubatão

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

O novo terminal rodoviário de Cubatão (SP) começa a funcionar em 1º de dezembro, ainda em fase de adaptação e testes. Inicialmente, três linhas municipais e duas intermunicipais, com destinos para São Paulo e São Bernardo do Campo, operarão no local. As informações são da prefeitura.

Localizada na Avenida Joaquim Jorge Peralta, no Jardim Casqueiro, a rodoviária funcionará das 5h às 21h. Durante esse período, serão avaliadas a circulação dos veículos, a movimentação de passageiros e a necessidade de possíveis ajustes e melhorias.

Ao g1, a Prefeitura de Cubatão informou, em nota, que ainda não é possível prever quando o período de testes será finalizado. A ideia do órgão municipal é realizar ajustes para, futuramente, implementar o funcionamento total do terminal.

As obras para a construção da rodoviária receberam um investimento de R$ 13 milhões, viabilizado pela empresa Rumo como contrapartida ligada à ampliação de uma das linhas ferroviárias do município.

As linhas municipais 1 (Caraguatá), 4 (Jardim Nova República) e 11 (bairro Fabril) passarão pelo novo terminal. Segundo a prefeitura, as mudanças de itinerário ainda estão sendo definidas pela Companhia Municipal de Trânsito de Cubatão (CMT).

As viagens com destino à capital paulista, com parada no Terminal Jabaquara, e a São Bernardo do Campo, na região do ABC, serão feitas pela Viação Piracicabana. Futuramente, outras empresas de transporte rodoviário poderão operar no espaço.

articles.title: Reforma da Previdência em Campinas tem protesto e confusão na Câmara | G1
articles.standfirst: Manifestação contra a proposta enviada pela Prefeitura de Campinas teve empurra-empurra e exigiu a intervenção da Guarda Municipal; apesar da confusão, audiência pública seguiu até o fim.
articles.summary: A proposta de reforma da Previdência em Campinas, que eleva a idade mínima para até 65 anos, causou tumulto e exigiu a ação da Guarda Municipal durante audiência.
articles.body:
Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

A audiência pública para discutir a proposta de reforma da Previdência dos servidores municipais, enviada pela Prefeitura de Campinas à Câmara, foi marcada por protestos na noite desta terça-feira (24).

Durante uma tentativa de manifestação enquanto representantes dos trabalhadores se pronunciavam, houve empurra-empurra entre participantes, e a Guarda Municipal precisou ser acionada. Apesar da confusão, a sessão prosseguiu normalmente.

Segundo a assessoria de imprensa da Câmara, a audiência é conduzinda pela Comissão de Constituição e Legalidade, presidida pelo vereador Otto Alejandro, "que solicitou a presença da Guarda Municipal para conter a invasão à plenária dos trabalhos".

O g1 solicitou informações à Guarda Municipal, e a reportagem será atualizada assim que a corporação se posicionar.

Entre as mudanças previstas no projeto está o aumento da idade mínima para aposentadoria dos futuros servidores. Para mulheres, a idade passaria dos atuais 55 para 62 anos. Para homens, subiria de 60 para 65 anos - entenda o que prevê a proposta abaixo.

A discussão sobre o projeto provocou grande mobilização dos servidores, que lotaram o Plenário da Casa, e também marcaram presença no lado de fora da Câmara na noite desta terça-feira (24).

A administração municipal afirma que a mudança é necessária para adequar as regras locais à reforma da Previdência aprovada pelo governo federal em 2019 e para enfrentar um déficit atuarial estimado em R$ 13 bilhões no Instituto de Previdência Social do Município de Campinas (Camprev).

Audiência pública na noite desta terça-feira (24) discutiu o projeto de reforma da Previdência de Campinas (SP); servidores cobram a retirada da proposta da Câmara Municipal — Foto: Câmara Municipal de Campinas

O que muda na idade mínima para aposentadoria?

A principal alteração está na idade exigida para os futuros servidores.

Como é hoje Mulheres: 55 anos Homens: 60 anos

Como ficaria Mulheres: 62 anos Homens: 65 anos

Além da idade mínima, serão exigidos 25 anos de contribuição, 10 anos de serviço público e 5 anos no cargo.

➡ Na prática , mulheres poderão ter que trabalhar até 7 anos a mais e homens poderão ter que trabalhar até 5 anos a mais.

A alíquota de contribuição permanece em 14%, segundo a proposta.

Prefeitura de Campinas propõe reforma da previdência — Foto: Prefeitura de Campinas

25 anos de contribuição exclusivamente em funções de magistério;

A proposta cria regras específicas para servidores expostos permanentemente a agentes nocivos à saúde, como médicos intensivistas e outras categorias previstas na legislação.

comprovação da exposição aos agentes nocivos.

O projeto regulamenta esse tipo de aposentadoria no município.

Por idade 55 anos para mulheres; 60 anos para homens; 15 anos de contribuição.

Por tempo de contribuição Deficiência grave: 20 anos para mulheres e 25 anos para homens; Deficiência moderada: 24 anos para mulheres e 29 anos para homens; Deficiência leve: 28 anos para mulheres e 33 anos para homens.

O prédio da Prefeitura de Campinas — Foto: Carlos Bassan / PMC

Quem já tiver cumprido todos os requisitos para aposentadoria antes da publicação da nova lei poderá se aposentar pelas regras atuais. A proteção também vale para aposentados, pensionistas e servidores que já tenham adquirido esse direito.

Já os servidores que ainda não tiverem completado todos os requisitos serão enquadrados em regras de transição previstas no projeto .

Para quem já trabalha na prefeitura e ainda não completou os requisitos para se aposentar, o projeto cria duas regras de transição: sistema de pontos e pedágio de 100%.

Exige idade mínima, tempo de contribuição e uma pontuação obtida pela soma da idade com o tempo de contribuição.

A pontuação aumenta gradualmente nos anos seguintes.

O servidor terá que cumprir o tempo que ainda falta para atingir os requisitos mínimos e trabalhar um período adicional equivalente.

➡ Exemplo: se faltarem dois anos para alcançar o tempo mínimo de contribuição, será necessário cumprir esses dois anos e mais dois anos de pedágio, totalizando quatro anos.

Mulheres 57 anos de idade 30 anos de contribuição

Homens 60 anos de idade 35 anos de contribuição

Veja o que prevê a proposta de reforma previdenciária dos servidores de Campinas

Segundo a Prefeitura de Campinas, a reforma também prevê medidas de financiamento para reduzir o déficit atuarial do Camprev, incluindo contribuições suplementares do município, aportes periódicos e outras fontes de receita previstas na proposta.

articles.title: Diarista acusada de matar casal em BH diz que 'ouviu vozes' | G1
articles.standfirst: Paola Stefany Neto Cirino foi interrogada nesta terça-feira (24), no Fórum Lafayette. Ela afirmou não se lembrar de parte dos acontecimentos.
articles.summary: Em depoimento, a diarista acusada de matar casal em BH alegou ter sofrido um surto com vozes pedindo sangue, mas laudo do IML descartou a sua insanidade mental.
articles.body:
Paola Stefany Neto Cirino é a principal suspeita de ter matado casal de idosos em apartamento de luxo em BH — Foto: Redes sociais

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

A diarista Paola Stefany Neto Cirino, acusada de matar e roubar um casal no bairro São Pedro , em Belo Horizonte , afirmou à Justiça que ouviu vozes exigindo o "sangue das vítimas" e ameaçando seu filho antes do crime. Ela foi interrogada nesta terça-feira (24), durante o segundo e último dia de audiências do processo , no Fórum Lafayette.

No depoimento, a ré também disse ter visto um caixão branco e alegou não se lembrar com clareza de parte dos acontecimentos, incluindo o momento em que teria colocado medicamentos no suco dos idosos para dopá-los ( leia mais abaixo ).

A diarista é acusada de matar o advogado Cláudio Atala Inácio, de 75 anos, e a empresária Maria Clotilde Moreira Maciel Atala Inácio, de 76, em 29 de junho deste ano. Ela está presa preventivamente na Penitenciária José Abranches Gonçalves, em Ribeirão das Neves.

Durante o interrogatório, Paola contou que chegou ao apartamento do casal por volta das 7h e foi recebida cordialmente por Maria Clotilde, que lhe ofereceu café e disse que prepararia o almoço para todos.

Segundo a acusada, a empresária estava vendendo alguns objetos por causa de uma mudança e pediu ajuda para embalá-los e colocar preços. Por volta das 11h30, a patroa teria solicitado que ela adiantasse a limpeza da suíte do casal.

Ao entrar no quarto, a diarista afirmou ter visto dinheiro e outros objetos de valor. A partir desse momento, disse não se recordar com clareza do que aconteceu.

Paola ainda relatou que começou a ouvir vozes pedindo "sangue" e passou a ver um caixão branco. Conforme ela, as vozes diziam que, se não fosse o sangue do casal, seria o de seu filho.

A mulher também afirmou se lembrar apenas de ter esfaqueado Maria Clotilde, que tentou se defender. De acordo com a acusada, quando começou a recobrar a consciência, abraçou e beijou o corpo da empresária, pedindo perdão.

Ainda conforme o depoimento, depois do crime, Paola ficou assistindo a um jogo da Seleção Brasileira. Ela afirmou que as vozes passaram a ordenar que cometesse suicídio, jogando-se pela janela do apartamento.

Durante o interrogatório, Paola também falou sobre o destino dos objetos retirados da residência. Ela afirmou que vendeu os pertences na região da Praça Sete, no Centro de Belo Horizonte, e que não conhecia os compradores.

Entre eles estaria o homem que utilizou os cartões bancários das vítimas e dividiu com ela os valores obtidos.

A diarista também contou que telefonou para Vinícius Mitre, responsável por indicá-la ao casal, após o crime. Segundo ela, os dois estavam começando um relacionamento.

Na ligação, Paola afirmou apenas que havia terminado a faxina e disse não ter tido coragem de contar o que aconteceu.

Sobre a fuga para Itabira, na Região Central de Minas Gerais, a acusada afirmou que escolheu a cidade por ter parentes no local e que queria proteger o filho.

Ela disse ainda que já havia decidido se entregar à polícia depois de ver a família na televisão, antes mesmo da chegada dos agentes.

Paola também relatou ter tentado tirar a própria vida na prisão, após voltar a ouvir as mesmas vozes que, segundo ela, escutou no dia dos assassinatos.

A diarista afirmou que estava em uma sala isolada porque havia agredido outra detenta no presídio.

“Não estou com os meus remédios certos, por isso fico ansiosa e agressiva”, declarou durante o interrogatório.

Ao todo, 12 pessoas foram convocadas para prestar depoimento entre segunda (23) e terça-feira (24).

No primeiro dia, foram ouvidas as testemunhas de acusação, incluindo investigadores da Polícia Civil, um motorista de aplicativo e um familiar das vítimas. No segundo, foram ouvidas testemunhas indicadas pela defesa e a própria ré.

As audiências foram marcadas pelo juiz Alexandre Magno de Resende Oliveira, da 2ª Vara Criminal de Belo Horizonte, após a conclusão de uma perícia psiquiátrica realizada para avaliar as condições mentais da acusada.

O exame havia sido determinado a pedido da defesa, depois que o magistrado identificou dúvidas sobre a capacidade de Paola de compreender o caráter ilícito dos próprios atos no momento do crime.

De acordo com uma decisão anterior, a diarista afirmou ter agido durante um "surto psicótico". O juiz também considerou relatos sobre o histórico de instabilidade emocional da acusada, atendimentos psiquiátricos e uso de medicamentos controlados.

Com a conclusão da perícia, a Justiça determinou a retomada do processo, que estava suspenso. O laudo pericial produzido pelo IML descartou insanidade mental da acusada .

O magistrado também afastou a possibilidade de absolvição sumária da ré, por entender que os argumentos apresentados pela defesa precisam ser analisados durante a produção de provas.

Paola Stefany Neto Cirino foi denunciada pelo Ministério Público pela morte do advogado Cláudio Atala Inácio , de 75 anos, e da empresária Maria Clotilde Moreira Maciel Atala Inácio, de 76. O crime ocorreu em 29 de junho, no apartamento do casal, no bairro São Pedro, em Belo Horizonte.

Segundo a denúncia, a diarista colocou clonazepam em um suco para dopar as vítimas e roubá-las. Durante o roubo, o advogado teria acordado e tentado reagir, momento em que foi atacado com uma faca. A esposa dele também foi morta.

Ainda conforme o Ministério Público, Paola levou mais de R$ 19 mil em dinheiro, além de joias, relógios, celulares, cartões bancários, perfumes, roupas, bolsas e outros objetos de valor . Parte dos bens foi vendida poucas horas depois no Centro de Belo Horizonte.

A diarista foi presa em 2 de julho, em um hotel em Itabira, na Região Central de Minas Gerais. Em 31 de julho, a Justiça aceitou a denúncia do MP e tornou Paola ré por latrocínio (roubo que resultou em morte) duas vezes, fraude processual e furto mediante fraude.

articles.title: Inmet emite alerta laranja para regiões do RJ | G1
articles.standfirst: Aviso de perigo prevê chuva intensa, rajadas de vento, queda de granizo e risco de alagamentos até o fim desta quarta-feira (25).
articles.summary: Aviso de perigo prevê chuva intensa, rajadas de vento, queda de granizo e risco de alagamentos até o fim desta quarta-feira (25).
articles.body:
O Inmet alerta para risco de corte de energia elétrica, danos em plantações, queda de árvores e alagamentos. — Foto: Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia (Inmet)

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

O Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia ( Inmet ) emitiu um alerta de tempestade com grau de severidade de perigo para municípios das regiões Serrana, Lagos e Norte Fluminense. O aviso é válido para esta quarta-feira (25).

Segundo o instituto, a previsão é de chuva entre 30 e 60 milímetros por hora ou de 50 a 100 milímetros por dia, além de ventos intensos que podem variar entre 60 e 100 km/h. Também há possibilidade de queda de granizo.

O Inmet alerta para risco de corte de energia elétrica, danos em plantações, queda de árvores e alagamentos.

Em caso de rajadas de vento, a orientação é não se abrigar debaixo de árvores devido ao risco de queda e descargas elétricas. Também é recomendado evitar estacionar veículos próximos a torres de transmissão e placas de propaganda.

O instituto recomenda ainda desligar aparelhos elétricos e o quadro geral de energia, quando possível.

articles.title: Dólar: moeda cai com ajuste fiscal e expectativa de corte de gastos | G1
articles.standfirst: A curva de juros futuros passou a projetar um cenário melhor para os negócios, com taxas mais baixas à frente.
articles.summary: O dólar registrou queda nesta terça-feira (24) após a Câmara aprovar o ajuste fiscal, enquanto investidores aguardam novos cortes de gastos do governo federal.
articles.body:
Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

No dia seguinte à aprovação do ajuste fiscal na Câmara dos Deputados , o dólar caiu nesta terça-feira (24). Também contribuiu para essa queda a expectativa dos investidores de que o governo anuncie novas medidas para equilibrar as contas públicas.

Se na segunda-feira (23) o dólar chegou a superar os R$ 6, nesta terça-feira (24) foi negociado a R$ 5,80 pela manhã e terminou o dia a R$ 5,91, com queda de 0,27%. Analistas de mercado se dizem mais confiantes.

"O governo estava demorando a dar um aceno de que faria os cortes necessários. Acontece ontem a aprovação de um corte ali importante - R$ 50, 60 bi. Durante o dia de hoje vem mais uma sinalização da equipe econômica para olhar com mais atenção, por exemplo, para as despesas obrigatórias. Isso poderia incrementar ainda mais cortes ao Orçamento, o que poderia ser bem visto pelo mercado", afirma Daniel Teles, sócio da Valor Investimentos.

De um mês pra cá, a moeda americana ganhou força em quase todas as grandes economias, e foi no Brasil que ela teve a maior valorização: 18%. O dólar corre sempre na direção do fluxo do dinheiro. Quando o capital estrangeiro entra no país, a cotação cai. Quando sai, acontece o contrário. E entre os dias 26 de outubro e 19 de novembro, os investidores estrangeiros retiraram mais de R$ 12 bilhões da bolsa brasileira, ainda que o saldo do ano seja positivo.

Dólar cai após aprovação do ajuste fiscal e expectativa de investidores sobre anúncio de novas medidas do governo para equilibrar contas — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

A curva de juros futuros passou a projetar um cenário melhor para os negócios, com taxas mais baixas à frente. Na avaliação dos investidores, se o compromisso do governo com o equilíbrio das contas públicas for colocado em prática, isso abre espaço para o corte da Selic, a taxa básica de juros do país.

"A Fazenda preocupada em bater ali superávit, em entregar as metas de crescimento, o corte de gasto necessário faz com que a curva de juros ela caia e o risco, o prêmio de risco para se comprar Brasil como um todo, através do Tesouro Direto, ele seja menor. Ou seja, o investidor ele aceita receber menos para investir dinheiro no Brasil", diz Daniel Teles.

A bolsa passou boa parte do dia em alta e fechou em baixa influenciada pela queda das ações da Vale e da Petrobras. Além do anúncio de novas medidas de ajuste fiscal, o mercado financeiro espera a definição da próxima equipe econômica. Luiz Fernando Figueiredo, que já foi diretor do Banco Central, diz que a saúde da economia depende do compromisso do governo:

"O que precisa ter, de maneira clara por parte do governo, o discurso de que precisamos, sim, fazer um ajuste, que será um ajuste gradual, mas ele acontecerá de fato. Porque ele é necessário, de maneira que a gente tenha uma situação de sustentabilidade fiscal ao longo do tempo. Que não precisa ser amanhã, ela precisa acontecer ao longo do tempo. Essa sinalização acaba fazendo com que todos os agentes econômicos falem: opa, espera um pouquinho. Não está bem a situação fiscal, mas ela vai ficar bem ao longo do tempo. Então, eu acho que o cenário vai melhorar para frente".

articles.title: Peixes mortos se acumulam em gradil do Parque da Aclimação após chuva; moradores relatam problema recorrente | G1
articles.standfirst: Lago que fica na região central de São Paulo recebe água dos córregos Pedra Azul e Jurubatuba; durante tempestades, força d'água arrasta os peixes, que acabam levados até a estrutura de proteção e ficam presos.
articles.summary: Lago que fica na região central de São Paulo recebe água dos córregos Pedra Azul e Jurubatuba; durante tempestades, força d'água arrasta os peixes, que acabam levados até a estrutura de proteção e ficam presos.
articles.body:
Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

Dezenas de peixes mortos foram encontrados na manhã desta terça-feira (24) no lago do Parque da Aclimação, na Zona Sul de São Paulo. Frequentadores registraram em vídeos os animais acumulados sobre um gradil de proteção instalado na área de escoamento da água ( veja vídeo acima ).

Segundo moradores e frequentadores do parque, a situação se repete quando chove forte e o volume de água aumenta, tanto na região do gradil quanto nas margens.

O lago recebe água dos córregos Pedra Azul e Jurubatuba e, durante tempestades, a força da água pode arrastar os peixes, que acabam levados até a estrutura de proteção e ficam presos.

Frequentador do parque há dez anos, o empresário Bruno Pereira afirmou que a morte de peixes é recorrente em períodos de chuva.

"É uma situação complicada, muitos peixes assim. E é uma situação corriqueira. Frequento há 10 anos e, sempre que chove, acontece", disse.

O jornalista Roberto Casseb também relatou episódios recentes. Segundo ele, duas chuvas fortes registradas no mês provocaram a morte de peixes no parque. Em uma delas, há cerca de três semanas, a água chegou a invadir casas de moradores da região e também levou peixes para esses imóveis.

"Só neste mês tivemos duas chuvas fortes que mataram peixes. A chuva de três semanas atrás encheu a casa das pessoas que moram aqui perto. Levou peixe para lá também. Isso é um problema que dá para prever, dá para resolver", afirmou.

Para o educador e mobilizador da Fundação SOS Mata Atlântica Cesar Pegoraro, uma das alternativas para reduzir o problema seria a instalação de jardins de chuva em vias públicas próximas ao parque.

Essas estruturas ajudam a reter e absorver a água da chuva antes que ela chegue ao lago, reduzindo o volume que entra no local durante temporais.

"Acho que o mais importante é pensarmos justamente em estruturas, por exemplo, como os jardins de chuva, que seriam estruturas construídas em vias públicas com essa função de parar a água, absorver essa água antes que ela chegue no lago. Essa seria uma estratégia barata, rápida de fazer e ajudaria muito a evitar a chegada de água. Evitar é sempre melhor do que tentar consertar o estrago feito", explicou.

Em nota, a Prefeitura de São Paulo afirmou que o lago passa por manutenções periódicas, que incluem serviços de limpeza e conservação das estruturas de contenção das águas.

A administração municipal também informou que uma equipe técnica monitora a fauna e a flora do parque. Diante das fortes chuvas que vêm atingindo a cidade, a Prefeitura disse que estuda alternativas para evitar novas ocorrências do tipo.

Dezenas de peixes ficam presos em um gradil e morrem no Parque da Aclimação — Foto: TV Globo

articles.title: Câmera flagra macaco fazendo pose em ponte de MT | G1
articles.standfirst: Imagens mostram diferentes espécies de macacos usando passarelas suspensas instaladas sobre ruas e avenidas de Alta Floresta.
articles.summary: Imagens mostram diferentes espécies de macacos usando passarelas suspensas instaladas sobre ruas e avenidas de Alta Floresta.
articles.body:
Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

Um macaco-prego chamou a atenção ao olhar diretamente para uma câmera e fazer uma espécie de pose enquanto atravessava uma ponte suspensa em Alta Floresta , a 800 km de Cuiabá. O registro faz parte de um monitoramento que acompanha o uso de passarelas instaladas sobre ruas e avenidas para permitir que animais silvestres circulem entre fragmentos de mata sem precisar passar pelo asfalto.

As imagens mostram diferentes espécies de macacos atravessando as pontes suspensas . Um dos registros que chama a atenção é o de um macaco-prego que olha diretamente para a câmera, faz uma careta e parece sorrir para a lente. (Veja vídeo acima)

Em outras cenas, bugios caminham pelas cordas, saguis atravessam saltitando e macacos-aranha se penduram pelos braços e pela cauda. Já outros macacos-prego aproveitam a estrutura para descansar e brincar.

As pontes de dossel foram criadas pela bióloga Fernanda Abra e começaram a ser instaladas no município no fim de 2024. A iniciativa busca reduzir o risco de atropelamentos em uma cidade cercada por áreas de vegetação, onde ruas e avenidas acabam interrompendo os caminhos naturais dos animais.

Segundo a bióloga, a movimentação é essencial para a sobrevivência das espécies, que precisam se deslocar em busca de alimento, água e território. Desde a instalação, o monitoramento registrou mais de 17 mil travessias de seis espécies de macacos.

Entre elas está o zogue-zogue-de-Alta-Floresta, espécie criticamente ameaçada de extinção. Outro resultado apontado pelo projeto é que, em quase dois anos de acompanhamento, não houve registro de atropelamentos de macacos nos sete pontos que receberam as passarelas

articles.title: UK warns British firms supporting Ukraine of potential Russian sabotage attacks
articles.summary: British security officials on Tuesday warned UK companies supporting Ukraine's military to prepare for potential sabotage attempts by Russia, in a rare
articles.body: British security officials on Tuesday warned UK companies supporting Ukraine's military to prepare for potential sabotage attempts by Russia, in a rare public warning.The alert was issued by the National Protective Security Authority (NPSA), part of Britain's domestic intelligence agency MI5, and the ministry of defence. They warned companies providing "material support" to Ukraine's armed forces that they could become targets for Moscow.According to the ministry of defence, chief executives of defence and critical infrastructure companies were being briefed privately by government ministers.The alert cited an increase in Russian attempts to sabotage European defence facilities in recent months, either directly or through proxies."Russia has increased sabotage attempts against European defence facilities in recent months, usually through proxies employing low-sophistication methods such as arson. Other hostile activities could include intimidation of individuals, espionage and information operations, all aimed at eroding support for Ukraine," the alert said.The alert advised companies to limit their online presence, strengthen security at their facilities, identify "potential hostile observation locations" and train employees to recognise "suspicious activity".The warning follows comments by MI5 chief Ken McCallum last month about the growing threat posed by "hostile" states, particularly Iran and Russia."Russia is using tactics that stop short — though sometimes not much short — of conventional conflict," McCallum warned.Russian 'sabotage' sweeps across EuropeAccording to an Associated Press tally, more than 210 incidents across Europe have been linked to suspected Russian sabotage or other hostile activities since the Russia-Ukraine war began on February 24, 2022. These include arson, espionage, cyberattacks, sabotage and attempted assassinations.Officials say the attacks aim to undermine support for Kyiv, spread fear and discord in European societies, and divert resources towards investigations. Russia frequently uses proxies to carry out such operations, with some perpetrators unaware that they have been recruited by Moscow.Estonian authorities have blamed Russia's security services for an arson attack in August on a defence company that supplies military vehicles to Ukraine.Estonia will shut all its border crossings with Russia from December 1 after authorities foiled another alleged attack on a defence company. Eight Latvian citizens were detained on suspicion of carrying out an arson attack allegedly ordered by Russian military intelligence, according to the Estonian and Latvian domestic security services.In the UK, a court convicted several men over a 2024 plot to set fire to a London warehouse containing supplies for Kyiv. In September, a British man was charged with conspiring with Russian spies to sabotage a drone factory, while an American soldier stationed at a British military base was arrested earlier this month on suspicion of spying for Russia.Authorities in Poland, Romania and other Nato member states have also reported disrupting multiple sabotage plots allegedly backed by Moscow.You use AI every day. articles.title: West Midlands teenager Suleymaan Khan beat 20,000 entries worldwide to win Alibaba's $200,000 CoCreate Pitch prize for SuleyNova Robotics, the coding kit brand he built after teaching himself to code
articles.summary: West Midlands teenager Suleymaan Khan has won a $200,000 prize from Alibaba.com after beating 20,000 entries from around the world with his educational
articles.body: West Midlands teenager Suleymaan Khan has won a $200,000 prize from Alibaba.com after beating 20,000 entries from around the world with his educational robotics business, SuleyNova Robotics. Khan, a self-taught robotics engineer from Birmingham, came first in the CoCreate Pitch competition at Alibaba.com's CoCreate Europe event in London. According to Alibaba.com, his business creates hands-on robotics kits that help young people learn coding and engineering through practical projects. The prize package is worth $200,000, with half of the award given as cash that does not require Khan to give up any ownership of his business. The other half comes in the form of platform credits and business support services.After his win, Suleymaan Khan, founder of SuleyNova Robotics, said: "I feel so passionate about learning how things work and creating tools that can provide young people with practical skills in robotics engineering. This has been the most incredible experience with Alibaba.com. Throughout, I've maintained a positive mindset, and manifested that this would happen. Now, I will use this fantastic prize to market and scale SuleyNova Robotics into a business that can empower the next generation of robotic engineers."Competition in London and fellow finalistsThe final pitch event took place in London on 20 November 2026 as part of Alibaba.com's main European event for sourcing and business owners. Organisers selected 20 finalists from an original pool of 20,000 applications from around the world. Each finalist had just 90 seconds on stage to present their product to a panel of judges before answering their questions. The founders travelled from across Europe and the United States, representing countries including the UK, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Slovenia, Austria and the US. Several other UK businesses also reached the final 20 alongside SuleyNova Robotics Ltd. They included Pelle Labs, Barbuddy, TreviTek (ScaldStop), hangAIR Global and Branch Brush. Aarav Rao, founder of US-based FreshSense, came second and won $100,000, while Giovanni Tuccari, from Italian company Clean OS, finished third and received $50,000.Alibaba backs young engineering talentAlibaba.com executives said Khan's robotics kits had strong business potential as more young people look for ways to enter careers in automation and software. Patrick Sostmann, General Manager Europe at Alibaba.com, said: "This year's CoCreate Europe has offered SMEs from across Europe a unique opportunity to level-up their businesses through agentic AI for commerce. Agentic AI is unlocking a new era of entrepreneurship that is agile, data-driven, and is highly autonomous, enabling founders to focus on developing new innovations and bringing products to market."Sostmann also praised Khan's work and said the win was only the start of his business journey. "As we celebrate and recognise some of the best product innovations from across Europe, we're delighted to have named Suleymaan from SuleyNova Robotics as our Grand Winner this year. His story is inspirational but really this is just the beginning. As young people increasingly seek to enter the robotics and engineering industry, SuleyNova Robotics has huge potential to scale with a difference. We look forward to working with Suley to take SuleyNova Robotics to new heights," he said.From bedroom builds to industrial roboticsKhan's interest in engineering began years before his pitch in London. In a July 2026 interview with small business network Enterprise Nation, the Birmingham teenager said he started building simple robots using cardboard and string when he was just five years old. By the age of 10, he had started his own YouTube channel to share videos of his projects. At 13, he won a national Network Rail Innovation Award at the Big Bang Fair with a humanoid robot he had built. Khan has also spoken about finding traditional classroom learning difficult. He told Enterprise Nation that he learned through online videos, books and trial and error rather than through formal academic study. "It all came from passion. I taught myself through YouTube, social media, reading different books, just through curiosity," he told Enterprise Nation.At 15, Khan took an unusual approach to a job interview at Japanese robotics manufacturer FANUC UK. Instead of bringing a standard CV, he took along a working robot he had built himself. He secured a robotics engineering apprenticeship as a maintenance technician. The role involved travelling across the UK to programme industrial robot arms, while he continued developing his own business in his spare time.Growing SuleyNova RoboticsUK Companies House records show that the business was first registered in August 2023 under the name SK Robotics & Electrical Engineering Ltd. It changed its name to SuleyNova Robotics Ltd in October 2025. The company's main product is a programmable robotic hand kit that learners can build and code at home. Khan previously redesigned the kit from the ground up to make it easier for beginners to understand how mechanical parts and software work together. With $100,000 in cash that does not require him to give up a share of his business, along with another $100,000 in sourcing and commercial support from Alibaba.com, Khan plans to increase marketing and production. He hopes to bring SuleyNova Robotics to more young people who want to learn engineering.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: 'Customary practices, age-old traditions': Thiruparankundram temple clarifies why deepam was lit at usual spot
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Arulmigu Subramaniya Swamy Temple on Tuesday issued a clarification after the Karthigai Deepam was lit at the usual spot instead of the
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Arulmigu Subramaniya Swamy Temple on Tuesday issued a clarification after the Karthigai Deepam was lit at the usual spot instead of the 'Deepathoon', despite the Supreme Court's order.In a statement, the temple's deputy commissioner and executive officer said that the Deepam is traditionally lit at the Deepa Mandapam located near the Uchipillaiyar Temple atop the hill."Specifically, as per the long-standing customary practice of the temple, the Karthigai Maha Deepam is traditionally lit at the Deepa Mandapam located near the Uchipillaiyar Temple atop the hill, directly above the sanctum of the presiding deity (Moolavar)," the statement read."Such long-standing and continuous religious practices (age-old continued practices), along with customs and rituals and Agama rules, are considered distinctive religious traditions and integral aspects of the temple's identity," it added.The statement said that the temple's board of trustees had unanimously passed a resolution stating that its age-old traditions and customary practices must be protected."Therefore, the temple's board of trustees has unanimously passed a resolution stating that the age-old traditions, customary practices, Agama regulations and established religious practices followed at the temple must be protected. Based on historical records establishing the continuity and religious significance of these practices, Agama-related documents and the opinions of temple functionaries (Sthanikars), the Board resolved to light the Karthigai Maha Deepam this year as well at the customary location," the statement read."It also resolved that the temple's traditions and customary practices should be brought to the attention of the court," it added."In accordance with the above resolution passed by the Board of Trustees, the Karthigai Maha Deepam of the temple was lit today, November 24, 2026, at around 6.00 pm, at the Deepa Mandapam near the Uchipillaiyar Temple atop the hill, directly above the sanctum of the presiding deity (Moolavar)," it added.This comes after a scuffle broke out between members of Hindu outfits and police officials at Thiruparankundram after the Karthigai Deepam was lit at the usual spot instead of the ‘Deepathoon’, despite the Supreme Court's order.Tamil Nadu law minister R Nirmal Kumar said in a brief statement that the Deepam was lit at the Deepa Mandapam, close to the Uchipillaiyar Temple, which is right above the shrine of the presiding deity, Lord Subramania Swamy.The ceremony was held amid heightened security, with police detaining several people citing apprehensions of disorder based on intelligence inputs and their past conduct.The dispute centres on the demand by Hindu groups and a section of devotees to light a traditional oil lamp at the Deepathoon, a stone pillar on the upper reaches of Thiruparankundram hill, during the annual Karthigai Deepam festival.The Subramaniya Swamy Temple is situated at the foothills, while a Dargah is located near the hilltop. A Shiva temple is also situated on the hill.Hindu groups maintain that the stone pillar where they seek to light the lamp belongs to the temple, citing civil court decisions dating back about a century.Dargah officials and Muslim organisations have opposed the proposed lighting, citing its proximity to their place of worship. The dispute involves questions of ownership and the rights of the respective parties.On November 20, the Supreme Court permitted a one-time ceremonial lighting of the Karthigai Deepam lamp at the hilltop Deepathoon on November 24, near the Sikkander Badusha Dargah.The apex court specified that the ceremony must be conducted by an authorised team and barred the general public, processions and gatherings at the hilltop site to maintain law and order.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: Why Jensen Huang return to Nvidia matters to America's AI ambitions
articles.summary: Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia is a victory for Donald Trump's pressure campaign, exposing how closely corporate power, politics and national security
articles.body: Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia is a victory for Donald Trump's pressure campaign, exposing how closely corporate power, politics and national security have become intertwined in America's battle for AI dominance.The Nvidia chief, who stepped down less than two weeks ago, is back at the helm after Trump personally pushed for his reinstatement, turning a corporate leadership crisis into a major political intervention.According to a CNN report, the Trump administration played a direct role in Huang's comeback, with senior officials engaging with the company over concerns surrounding his departure and its implications for US national security.How Trump mounted pressure to bring Huang backTrump's intervention went beyond publicly backing Huang. The US president personally pushed for his return, while Vice-President JD Vance also stepped in, contacting Huang and members of Nvidia's board over the weekend. The outreach put the administration directly in the middle of a corporate leadership crisis.Trump later acknowledged his role in the reinstatement, presenting Huang's return as an important development for American business and technological leadership.The pressure campaign reflected the administration's concern that losing the head of the world's most valuable AI chipmaker could have wider consequences for America's position in the global technology race.Huang's importance to Washington goes far beyond his role as Nvidia's chief executive. The company has become central to America's artificial intelligence industry, supplying advanced graphics processing units (GPUs) that power data centres, train AI models and support the development of increasingly sophisticated computing systems.With Washington seeking to maintain its technological edge over China, Nvidia's chips have become a strategic asset. The company's dominance in the AI hardware market also gives Huang considerable influence over the direction of the global technology industry. His continued leadership is therefore closely tied to America's ambitions to remain ahead in the AI race.China links put Nvidia under national security scrutinyHowever, Nvidia's growing importance to US technological leadership has also placed the company under intense scrutiny over its China business. Washington has been concerned that advanced American AI chips could be diverted to China, potentially giving Beijing access to computing capabilities that the US is trying to restrict.The concerns have also drawn attention to Singapore-based Megaspeed, which has faced scrutiny over suspected involvement in the diversion of Nvidia chips.The case highlights the challenges facing US authorities as they attempt to enforce export controls and prevent sensitive semiconductor technology from reaching China.Nvidia's market power and the AI rallyHuang's return has also had significant implications for financial markets. Nvidia's position at the centre of the global AI boom means any uncertainty surrounding its leadership can ripple across the broader technology sector.Investors have closely watched the company's leadership and business outlook as demand for AI chips continues to drive market valuations. Huang's reinstatement has therefore been seen as a reassuring development for investors betting on the continued expansion of the AI industry.The immediate market reaction underscored that confidence, with Nvidia shares surging following the announcement of Huang's return. The rally also lifted broader US stock indices, reflecting the chipmaker's enormous influence on investor sentiment and the wider AI trade.However, the market optimism does not settle the questions surrounding Nvidia's China business, export-control compliance or the administration's role in the company's leadership.Huang's return may have eased investor concerns, but the national security scrutiny facing the company remains.You use AI every day. articles.title: Norway once pushed screens into classrooms; now it’s restoring access to textbooks as students score below OECD averages in reading, math, and science
articles.summary: Norway is re-evaluating its classroom technology approach, reintroducing physical textbooks to combat declining student proficiency in reading, math, and science, as education officials seek a balanced integration of tech in schools.
articles.body: Every teacher wants the best for their students; however, disagreements often arise over how to achieve it. Around three years ago, a Norwegian schoolteacher landed in trouble for trading iPads for pen and paper, according to Phys.org. Now, Norwegian officials and educators have begun re-evaluating the role of classroom technology. After making laptops and screens the norm in schools nationwide, Norway moved to reintroduce physical textbooks to counter a steep drop in students’ reading and writing proficiency.To regain control over how technology is used rather than passively accept its consequences, this reassessment in the tech-savvy country is going beyond the classroom. In an interview with AFP, Norway's Digitalization Minister Torgeir Micaelsen stated that screens were most likely introduced in the schools too quickly, before officials established a good understanding of their impacts or defined best practices to use them efficiently.The debate between tablets and textbooks For almost two decades, Norway has placed immense importance on computers and tablets in classrooms, a trend accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic. Beginning in 2023, Oslo primary schools were even meant to provide each student with their own digital device.However, one day, a third-grade teacher named Pål Ludvig Finstad decided to break the prevailing regulations. During his class, he told his students to put away their tablets and use pen and paper instead to help those struggling with reading and writing.In a 2024 interview with the newspaper Klassekampen, the teacher explained why he made the move, noting he believed that the students needed a different approach at that stage. As a result, he received a written warning from the school administration, according to AFP. Ironically, the Oslo municipality has just removed its mandate for one device per student in primary schools, giving schools greater flexibility in choosing their classroom tools.While speaking with AFP, primary school principal Silje mentioned that the screen wasn’t the main issue; rather, it was the manner in which it was utilized, specifically when the device became more crucial than the content. Ween further elaborated that just as a book was a helpful and essential tool, an iPad could serve the same role, as one didn’t rule out the other.A few ways to fix it In response to the ongoing debate regarding textbooks and tablets in the classrooms, Norwegian authorities took several necessary steps. Officials advised placing limits on the use of cellphones in schools and introducing artificial intelligence in the school curriculum only gradually. In addition, the government aimed to establish access to printed textbooks in legislation.A November 2024 report by Norway’s Screen Use Committee emphasized that students typically grasped lengthy texts better when reading them on paper than on screens. Results from the 2022 PISA study (published in December 2023), which evaluates the skills of 15-year-olds internationally, showed Norway performing below the OECD average in reading comprehension, mathematics, and science, marking its first simultaneous drop below average in all three fields since 2006, as cited by Phys.org.In 2024, Norway revealed plans to limit social media use to protect its youth. Officials announced plans to introduce legislation by the end of that year, prohibiting apps including TikTok, Snapchat, and the gaming platform Roblox for children under the age of 16. articles.summary: The husband of Sofia Hernandez Mejia, the Mexican woman who was detained by ICE officers while boarding an Alaska Airlines flight along with her father,
articles.body: The husband of Sofia Hernandez Mejia, the Mexican woman who was detained by ICE officers while boarding an Alaska Airlines flight along with her father, broke his silence about the entire incident and said he felt helpless as he was also there. Jose Castillo, a US citizen, said he felt helpless as masked immigration officers arrested his wife and her father, Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, on Saturday while the family was preparing to board a flight from Seattle to Los Angeles. Recalling the incident in an interview with CBS News on Monday, Castillo said the situation unfolded so quickly that he struggled to understand what was happening."You black out. You don't even know what's going on. You don't even know what's happening. Everything is moving so fast. Trying to protect your wife and they're taking your father-in-law," he said. "As a US citizen, you feel useless," he added.Castillo also expressed anger over the way the arrests were carried out, saying he was disgusted by the officers' actions. "How can you sit with yourself and strip somebody away like that in broad daylight, in front of families?" he said.What happened during the Alaska Airlines flight arrest?The incident took place on November 21 as passengers were boarding Alaska Airlines Flight 1306 at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport. The flight was scheduled to travel to Los Angeles. Videos of the confrontation circulated widely on social media, showing masked federal agents struggling with a person on the airport jet bridge as other passengers watched. Hernandez Mejia could be heard crying and telling officers that they were taking her father. She also said that the family had work authorization.According to Castillo, he was travelling with his wife and father-in-law to attend a family event when plainclothes ICE officers approached them on the jet bridge.DHS said the operation was targeting Larrondo Mendoza, a Mexican national who had overstayed his visa.The agency said other passengers began obstructing federal officers during the arrest. It also alleged that Hernandez Mejia threw hot coffee at immigration agents, prompting her detention. DHS said she would face federal charges of assaulting a federal officer.Castillo strongly disputed the allegation and said she did not assault anyone. "She did nothing. She was being shoved. They came directly at us." "When you're coming at me and my wife and you're shoving us, obviously coffee's going to be spilled," he added.The family's attorney, Olia Catala, has also challenged the government's account. She said Hernandez Mejia was holding a cup of coffee when the confrontation began and dropped it amid the commotion.Why were the father and daughter detained?DHS identified both Hernandez Mejia and Larrondo Mendoza as Mexican nationals who had overstayed their visas and were living in the United States without legal immigration status. Their attorney contended that the two entered the US legally on tourist visas in 2015 and had pending immigration applications.Catala said Larrondo Mendoza had a pending asylum application, while Hernandez Mejia had married a US citizen and applied for a green card through her marriage. She also said neither of her clients had a criminal record.The attorney argued that the father and daughter were attempting to follow the legal immigration process and should not have been detained. "Congress created legal pathways and Sofia and her father were using them," Catala said in a separate interview with CBS News."We can't tell immigrants to use the legal pathways, to follow the law and then punish them for doing just that," she added. Hernandez Mejia and her father remained in ICE custody in Tacoma, Washington, according to their lawyer. Castillo has appealed for their release, insisting that they did not deserve to be detained in the manner they were.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.body: A Queensland family received an unexpected alert from their Ring doorbell camera at 1.45 am on Sunday. Expecting to see someone standing outside their home, they checked the notification but found a carpet python hanging its head over the camera instead. The camera labelled the movement as a person. The unusual encounter took place at the family’s home in Twin Waters on the Sunshine Coast.According to 7NEWS (Australia), the camera notification identified the movement as a person, prompting the family to check the footage. The video showed the carpet python hanging over the doorbell before moving down in front of the camera.Doorbell camera mistakes carpet python for a visitor outside Queensland family’s homeThe family received the alert at 1.45 am on Sunday, while they were at home in Twin Waters. The Ring camera notification indicated that someone was at the front door.Snake catcher Dan Busstra said, “She had the light pop up saying that she has someone at her door. When she went to check it, there’s a carpet python hanging its head over the doorbell camera.”“At the bottom of the camera, it even says it’s a person!”The family had therefore been alerted to what the device interpreted as someone outside, rather than a snake passing across its view. The camera footage then showed the carpet python hanging over the doorbell before slithering down in front of it.The report included the video of the encounter and described the snake’s movement across the camera. The incident took place in the early hours, when the family was woken by the alert.Snake catcher explains why carpet pythons are less likely to fleeSnake catcher Dan Busstra said, “Pythons when left alone are chill and will cruise past you without a worry in the world, you know, where as eastern browns snakes are very flighty, very quick to run away. He said pythons left alone would usually move past people without causing concern. He compared their behaviour with that of eastern brown snakes, which he described as very flighty and quick to run away.Busstra added that pythons also try to avoid people, but are less likely to flee in the same way as venomous snakes. His comments offered context to the unexpected appearance at the family’s front door. The report identified the snake as a carpet python and noted that carpet pythons are non-venomous. articles.title: In 1916, a Utah banker mailed about 15,000 bricks, roughly 37 tons, nearly 400 miles by parcel post to build the Bank of Vernal because it was cheaper than freight, and the US Post Office quickly changed its rules
articles.summary: When does it become financially viable to ship a whole building's worth of bricks by postal service, as opposed to trucking them in?
articles.body: When does it become financially viable to ship a whole building's worth of bricks by postal service, as opposed to trucking them in? In 1916 a Utah banker discovered an unconventional solution to an expensive construction problem by using the US mail system as an unlikely delivery service for almost 37 tons of building material. The extraordinary decision helped build a historic bank in a remote town but also forced postal authorities to rethink how far they could stretch parcel post. It was a quirky episode, and it became one of the more memorable examples of the possibilities and the limits of America’s early parcel post.An expensive building challenge in rural UtahAccording to the United States Postal Service, the Bank of Vernal’s directors aimed to build a modern, fire-resistant building for their community in 1916. It was to be a two-storey structure 70 feet by 97 feet with pressed brick on the outside.But there was one big financial hurdle to buying the required materials. The closest source of brick was the Salt Lake Pressed Brick Company in Salt Lake City. The cost of hauling the brick over bad roads was high.The Almanac reports the expected cost to truck in the 15,000 bricks was roughly $2,250, potentially putting the construction project in jeopardy. Rather than scrapping the idea, one of the bank’s directors, William Horace Coltharp, began exploring other transportation options.How the parcel post became the solutionColtharp found that the postal rules were a much cheaper option. Parcel post, which had been established in 1913, had revolutionized the movement of merchandise throughout the United States by making it possible for ordinary customers to send heavier packages by the postal system.According to the National Postal Museum, before the parcel post, private express companies were the primary carriers of goods weighing more than four pounds. The introduction of the service made shipping much more readily available, especially for communities off the railroad networks.At first, the weight limit for parcel post was 11 pounds, but because of its popularity, it was expanded to 50 pounds within a year.Coltharp spotted the opportunity, and arranged to break the bricks into smaller shipments. Each package contained about 10 bricks, carefully wrapped in paper and placed in wooden crates that weighed under 50 pounds. The entire order contained something like 1,500 separate parcels.A 390 mile journey via several routesThe postal shipment, which came from Vernal, only about 125 miles away by road, traveled nearly 390 miles on a complicated transportation network to get to Salt Lake City.According to the Almanac, the crates were shipped first by rail from Salt Lake City to Mack, Colorado. They were then taken by narrow gage railroad to Watson, Co. The last leg was freight wagons to haul the packages approximately 65 miles to Vernal.The unusual route reflected the limitations of the transportation infrastructure in the region. Vernal did not lie directly on the rail network, making regular freight deliveries difficult and costly.By 1916, parcel post was already part of the fabric of everyday life in Vernal. The National Postal Museum notes that the town was receiving about two tons of mail each day.Postal authorities move to change the rulesEventually the huge shipments of bricks attracted the attention of postal officials, who wondered whether the postal service should be used to deliver such large quantities of building material.The United States Postal Service says the rules limited shipments from a single sender to a single recipient to 200 pounds per day.The bank directors, however, found another way to complete the deliveries. They recruited local farmers, ranchers and residents to each accept the packages. When the crates arrived, these volunteers carried them from the post office to the building site. The arrangement enabled the project to continue under the new restrictions.A curious postal legacy and a historic buildingThe Bank of Vernal was finished at last, the first brick building in town. The structure still exists today as a reminder of the extraordinary postal arrangement.The National Postal Museum has preserved one of the building’s original bricks to demonstrate the importance of the parcel post in linking America’s far-flung communities. The episode also showed how cheap postal services could encourage rural commerce, construction and access to consumer goods.What started as a cost-saving move by a Utah banker eventually revealed a loophole in postal regulations and led to a change in shipping rules, leaving behind an unusual chapter in American postal history.Images Courtesy: Almanac and National Postal MuseumYou use AI every day. It's not fair." BILL MAHER SAYS IT’S 'SO STUPID' FOR ANTI-TRUMP ARTISTS TO BAIL ON KENNEDY CENTER PERFORMANCES Mamet suggested her father was committing to a "bit" so much that he actually started to believe it. David Mamet is known for writing the stage play "Glengarry Glen Ross" and its film adaptation and won a Pulitzer Prize for it in 1984. Christian Toto, founder of "Hollywood in Toto," told Fox News Digital, "David Mamet's daughters can alleviate their fears in a very simple way. Ask Dad why he supports President Donald Trump. articles.body: A property developer has been fined £50,000 after the unauthorised demolition of a listed Georgian residence and two listed gate lodges at Brookfield House in Banbridge, Northern Ireland. The buildings dated back to around 1760 and were all Grade B2 listed. The penalty followed a hearing at Newry Magistrates’ Court on 2 November 2026, where BIG Contracts Ltd was fined for breaches of planning legislation. The company has since lodged an appeal against the court’s ruling.According to Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon Borough Council, its Planning Department took enforcement action following the demolition. The case involved protected historic buildings. The loss affected the borough’s built heritage and reiterated its commitment to protecting historic buildings.BIG Contracts Ltd fined £50,000 for demolishing listed buildingsBIG Contracts Ltd was fined £50,000 following a hearing at Newry Magistrates’ Court on 2 November 2026. The case concerned breaches of planning legislation relating to demolition work at Brookfield House in Banbridge. The Enniskillen-based property developer was penalised after the unauthorised demolition of listed buildings on the site.They comprised a Grade B2 listed Georgian residence and two Grade B2 listed gate lodges. The Planning Department at Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon Borough Council had successfully taken enforcement action against the company. BIG Contracts Ltd has lodged an appeal against the ruling.Demolition destroyed protected buildings dating back to around 1760The demolition at Brookfield House destroyed a Grade B2 listed Georgian residence and two gate lodges. Reportedly, the buildings dated back to around 1760. The residence and lodges were therefore protected buildings, and the planning case concerned their demolition without the required authorisation.Council Spokesperson said, “The Council is deeply disappointed at the loss of these protected buildings and the resulting loss to the borough’s built heritage. Listed buildings are protected because of their special architectural and historic significance and, once structures of this importance are demolished, that heritage value can never be replaced.”Listed buildings' demolition marked an irreplaceable loss to local heritageA spokesperson for Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon Borough Council welcomed the court’s ruling and the penalty. The council said it was deeply disappointed by the loss of the protected buildings and its effect on the borough’s built heritage.The spokesperson said, “Protecting and enhancing the borough’s built heritage remains a key priority for the Council. Through initiatives such as the Townscape Heritage Initiative, the Empty to Occupied Grant Scheme and our recently published Heritage Strategy, we are actively supporting the restoration, sensitive reuse and revitalisation of historic buildings across the borough as well as prioritising the preservation of our natural and cultural heritage.”What makes the preservation of historic buildings important for local identityBIG Contracts Ltd has appealed against the ruling that resulted in the £50,000 fine. The fine followed the 2 November 2026 hearing at Newry Magistrates’ Court, which dealt with planning legislation breaches linked to the demolition of the listed buildings at Brookfield House.The spokesperson said, “These initiatives recognise that protecting heritage is not simply about preventing the loss of important buildings. It is also about encouraging investment, finding sustainable new uses for historic properties and ensuring that our heritage continues to contribute positively to regeneration, vibrant town centres and a strong sense of place for future generations.”Disclaimer: This article is based on information published by Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon Borough Council. Revolta dos perus? Às vésperas antes do Dia de Ação de Graças nos Estados Unidos , uma mulher foi perseguida por perus selvagens —o prato principal do feriado— nas ruas de Massachusetts.

O episódio ocorreu no sábado (21) na cidade de Newton. A mulher caminhava pela calçada com passo acelerado e com perus andando atrás dela, quando foi resgatada por um casal de desconhecidos que passava de carro pelo local. Os passageiros falaram para que a mulher entrasse no veículo para se desvencilhar das aves, e ela não aparentava ter se ferido. Todos riram da situação logo depois.

Mulher é perseguida por perus selvagens na rua em Massachusetts, nos Estados Unidos, em 21 de novembro de 2026, às vésperas do Dia de Ação de Graças. — Foto: Reprodução/Taryn LaPrade no Facebook

A cena foi registrada pelos passageiros, que perguntaram se a mulher estava bem e se havia alimentado os perus. Inicialmente, duas aves a perseguiam e pareciam querer dar bicadas nela, e uma terceira apareceu pouco antes dela entrar no carro. Nas imagens, é possível ver outros perus na vizinhança. Veja no vídeo acima.

"Parecia uma gangue de perus. Eles pareciam ficar cada vez mais agressivos conforme nos aproximamos, então percebemos que ela precisava de ajuda. Foi bizarro, eu nunca vi nada assim", afirmou Taryn LaPrade, que gravou a cena, em entrevista à imprensa norte-americana.

O peru é tido como o prato dos principal do feriado do Dia de Ação de Graças, que acontece na quinta-feira (26). Com poucos predadores naturais, as aves têm aparecido cada vez mais nas cidades dos EUA. Segundo biólogos, os machos podem ser agressivos com um comportamento territorial e intimidador durante a época de reprodução.

Presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, e primeira-dama Melania Trump durante cerimônia de perdão de perus antes do Dia de Ação de Graças na Casa Branca, em Washington D.C., nos Estados Unidos, em 24 de novembro de 2026. — Foto: REUTERS/Evelyn Hockstein

Falando em Dia de Ação de Graças e em perus, o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, perdoou duas aves na Casa Branca na terça-feira (24) e as livrou de serem abatidas. A cerimônia típica ocorre todo ano na semana do feriado norte-americano.

O Dia de Ação de Graças é um dos feriados mais populares nos EUA, em que é registrado o maior deslocamento interno de pessoas, que viajam para estar junto de suas famílias.

Um afundamento de pista interditou totalmente um trecho da Rodovia Jornalista Francisco Aguirre Proença (SP-101), em Hortolândia (SP), na manhã desta quarta-feira (25). O bloqueio ocorreu no km 7, no sentido Campinas , e provocou congestionamento.

Conhecida como Rodovia Campinas-Monte Mor, a SP-101 cruza a Rodovia Anhanguera (SP-330), em Campinas, e é uma das vias de ligação entre municípios da região.

articles.body: The Saudi-led coalition launched an airstrike on Yemen's Hodeidah port after issuing an evacuation warning for the facility, escalating tensions with the Houthi group, which had threatened to target Saudi ports along the Red Sea coast in retaliation for any attack.The strike came after coalition spokesperson Major General Turki al-Maliki urged civilians to leave designated areas of the port for their safety. articles.title: All 6 passengers found dead inside wreckage of plane off Mississippi coast
articles.summary: All six passengers aboard the Cessna 210 Centurion that went down roughly 2 miles northeast of Horn Island, Mississippi, have been found dead, according to the U.S. Coast Guard.
articles.body: All six people aboard a small plane that crashed off the Mississippi Gulf Coast were found dead Wednesday morning, bringing a search-and-rescue operation to a tragic end, according to the U.S. Coast Guard (USCG). The USCG and partner agencies concluded their search after divers located the remains of all six people inside the aircraft's fuselage approximately 2 miles northeast of Horn Island, Mississippi. The victims' identities have not been released, but earlier authorities said they were searching for four adults and two boys between the ages of 8 and 12, according to local outlets WDSU and WLOX, citing the USCG. The Cessna 210 aircraft went down Tuesday afternoon, prompting a multi-agency search. It was descending at 10,000 feet per minute when it crashed, the outlets reported. BODY WASHED ASHORE IN OREGON IDENTIFIED AS FORMER CITY COUNCILOR MISSING SINCE SEPTEMBER PLANE CRASH "This is a heartbreaking outcome, and our deepest sympathies are with the families and loved ones who are facing an unimaginable loss," Cmdr. Trevor Blount, the Coast Guard Sector Mobile search and rescue mission coordinator, said in a statement. "While this is not the outcome any of us had hoped for, we are grateful for the strong interagency coordination that enabled us to swiftly locate those aboard the aircraft and provide closure to their families," Blount added. Coast Guard watchstanders in Mobile received a report from air traffic control at approximately 3:45 p.m. Tuesday that contact had been lost with the aircraft. articles.title: Russia's own figures show almost 500,000 deaths in war in Ukraine
articles.summary: Leaked data reveal how the full-scale invasion of Ukraine has fundamentally changed mortality patterns in Russia.
articles.body:
At least 490,334 Russian soldiers have died since the start of the war in Ukraine in 2022, according to Russian government statistics analysed by the BBC.

The leaked Rosstat data reveal how the full-scale invasion of Ukraine has fundamentally changed mortality patterns in Russia, and show the high cost paid in human life in a war that Vladimir Putin had assumed would last only days but is now almost five years old.

BBC Russian has had access to more than 11 million death records from 2021 to September 2026, after a hack by Belarusian group Cyber Partisans BY and Ukraine's Silent Crow.

Russia's statistics agency admitted to a cyber-attack, but denied any protected information had been leaked.

Together with independent Russian outlet Mediazona, BBC Russian has compared the Rosstat data with its own list of confirmed military deaths, pulled from open sources since the start of the invasion, and it has found matches for 90% of the records.

The records show that 65% of 18 to 24 year-olds in Russia who lost their lives in 2025 died in the war. For those aged 25-34 the number was 59%. Only among 45 to 54 year-olds does cardiovascular disease claim more Russian lives than the conflict.

The data also reveal the extent of losses in specific areas of Ukraine. Some 20,000 Russian soldiers died fighting for control of 10 Ukrainian villages whose combined pre-war population was 12,000.

During the fight for one small village called Andriivka, south of the town of Bakhmut in Donetsk region, 1,122 Russians lost their lives. Before the war 74 people lived there.

Russia does not give public figures for losses sustained since the war began in February 2022. And two years ago Rosstat stopped publishing data of deaths from external causes, which was used to gauge the extent of military losses.

For example, only 70% of deaths we have established of soldiers from the occupied regions of Donetsk and Luhansk in eastern Ukraine who fought in the Russian army were accounted for in the Rosstat files.

How we came to a figure near half a million

The Rosstat dataset contains no names but does include ages, places of residence, places of death and also circumstances of death.

We have filtered the records first by location, leaving only Ukraine as well as Russian border regions that saw incursions by the Ukrainian army.

Next, we identified 425,174 entries explicitly indicating a military-related cause of death, such as explosions or shrapnel during combat operations.

As this count could include civilians, we filtered out women as well as men outside the 18-65 age group. And if someone lived and died in the four Ukrainian regions occupied by Russia, we excluded them as a possible civilian – unless he had a record of military service attached to his entry.

Another 14,093 entries were identified by looking at employment, and 51,067 were recorded in the database as deceased on the basis of a court ruling. This often happens when a soldier goes missing in a combat zone for more than six months and their body has not been recovered.

Again, we filtered out civilians by only counting deaths in the war zones in Ukraine and Russia.

BBC Russian's own detailed records of Russian losses has reached 290,012, verified together with Mediazona from official reports, social media, new memorials and graves. The actual death toll is likely to be higher, as not all deaths are reported publicly.

Overall, the Rosstat dataset confirms the trends that we have observed with our own count.

According to BBC Russian's analysis of the leaked files, in the first year of the war the average age of those killed was 34. By 2025, as prisoners and contract soldiers entered the ranks, it had risen to 40 (38 according to our own list).

Some of Russia's poorest regions in Eastern Siberia account for a disproportionately large share of the losses. Men from Tyva, Buryatia and Zabaykalsky Krai are 20-25 times more likely to die in the war than residents of the biggest cities of Moscow and St Petersburg.

In most regions, the distribution of deaths based on Rosstat data differs from that in the BBC's list by just a few tenths of a percentage point.

At least 5,017 foreigners are among those who died fighting for Russia, according to our analysis of the Rosstat files, including 1,031 Uzbeks and 720 Tajiks. We have left out Ukrainians from this count to avoid including civilians.

This is a conservative estimate as dual nationals are listed as Russians in the database, and there is no reference to North Koreans who died repelling the Ukrainian incursion into Russia in 2024.

The BBC identified 2,304 North Korean soldiers who died there by analysing satellite imagery and official photographs of a newly built memorial in Pyongyang.

The leaked Russian statistics may not be complete but taken in conjunction with BBC Russian's own work they are significant. Military experts estimate that the BBC's figure of 290,012, gleaned from open sources, may account for 45-55% of the true death toll – ranging from 527,295 to 644,471.

In the context of a war that has lasted four years and 10 months, these are high numbers for Russia, when compared with the Soviet war in Afghanistan that ended in 1989.

Ukrainian losses were last put at about 50,000 by President Volodymyr Zelensky in July 2026, but another list based on open sources by the anonymous UA Losses website puts the figure at 115,952.
